generations.prompt: A production-ready 2 by 2 sprite sheet containing exactly four separate blank candy game tokens for a premium cheerful cartoon number-merging mobile game. Top-left: plump rounded pillow gummy. Top-right: compact wrapped candy with short symmetrical wrapper ends. Bottom-left: thick round hard-candy lozenge. Bottom-right: six-lobed flower bonbon. All four tokens share one coherent cream-sugar material, dark cocoa-brown outer rim, soft baked edge, subtle icing highlight, warm caramel inner shading, tactile toy-like 2.5D front view. Each token must have a large completely blank clean center reserved for a live number overlay. Exactly one token in each quadrant, centered, equal scale, no overlap, generous white space around every token. Pure flat white background. No letters, no numbers, no symbols, no faces, no decorations, no labels, no UI panels, no shadows outside the object, no gradients in the background.
generations.critique: No text or pseudo-glyphs; four isolated readable objects and clean centers. Deviations: top-left became the wrapped form, top-right became tart-like, and the flower has five lobes rather than six.

generations.prompt: One isolated production-ready cartoon game VFX sprite for a premium cheerful candy-workshop number-merging game: a compact hollow ring burst made of warm caramel ribbons, cream frosting curls, tiny sugar crystals, and six short restrained golden star rays. The exact center must remain a large clean empty white hole so a live game token and number stay fully readable. Strong radial silhouette, tactile confection material, dark cocoa accents, cozy cream-pink-honey palette, crisp 2D mobile-game illustration, front orthographic view. Exactly one burst only, centered, generous white margin. Pure flat white background. No candy token, no number, no letters, no text, no symbols, no badge, no UI panel, no fire, no smoke, no neon, no magic rune, no scene, no border.
generations.critique: The wreath is richer and thicker than a restrained flat VFX, but its large hollow center preserves the authoritative token and the material is specific to the approved workshop.
